entities.name: PMID:25096633
observations: Dutilh et al. 2014 comparative genomics study classified 274 complete V. cholerae genomes by niche using GWAS-M and genomic features including SNPs, protein families, functions, and prophages.

Authors reported genomic variation, especially mobile functions (phages, prophages, transposable elements, plasmids), associated with metadata structuring space, time, and habitat; interpretation included endemicity, temporal divergence, and habitat invasion.

entities.name: Vibrio cholerae niche structure
observations: Study analyzed 274 complete V. cholerae genomes across niche dimensions of space, time, and habitat; mobile genomic functions were reported as underlying metadata-associated structuring.
